D: A down-on-his-luck detective helps a cartoon rabbit framed for murder in 1947 Los Angeles.
P: Serve the drinks when Jessica takes the stage at the Ink and Paint Club.
S: the nightclub where toons wait tables
Devilled eggs, smoked salmon on rye and cocktail franks in a sticky glaze, served on silver trays like a 1940s supper club.
Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey, cumin and thyme until caramelised, with a whipped feta dip.
no toons harmed in this dip
French onion dip of onions cooked slowly for 40 minutes, folded into sour cream and cream cheese, with potato chips.
M: lunch at his desk in the office
A hot pastrami sandwich: pastrami steamed, piled on rye with mustard and Swiss, grilled until the cheese melts. Dill pickle on the side.
Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, mash and green beans.
W: Red velvet cake baked at 175C, layered with cream cheese frosting, a glossy red glaze on top.
K: the bottle in his desk drawer
45ml rye whisky neat or on the rocks in a heavy glass. Just don't give one to Roger.

s.note: the nightclub where toons wait tables
s.how: Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo. Top buttered rye squares with 100g smoked salmon. Glaze 16 cocktail franks in a pan with 2 tbsp brown sugar and a splash of water. Serve on silver trays.
Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cumin, thyme and oil. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip.

m.note: lunch at his desk in the office
m.how: Steam 400g pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Pile onto 8 slices rye with mustard and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle on the side.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer with cream cheese frosting and pour a glossy red icing over the top.

d.note: the bottle in his desk drawer
d.how: Pour 45ml rye whisky into each of four heavy glasses, neat or over a few cubes of ice, and sip it slowly at the desk. Whatever happens, do not give one to Roger, because he cannot handle it.
